title: The Cohomology of Solvmanifold SYZ Mirrors
summary: This paper investigates the geometric and cohomological properties of non-Kähler SYZ mirror symmetry for dual torus fibrations over solvmanifolds in the sense of Lau, Tseng and Yau.
